name: Red Chord
body:
School evocation [sonic]; Level bard 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, F (a musical instrument

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Area 20-ft.-radius spread
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You create a sound that resonates in the material and negative energy planes. All creatures within the spread take 1d4 damage per caster level. Half of the damage is sonic, the other half is negative energy. The negative energy does not heal undead, nor does it harm them.
